concordance.csv: the full concordance

Source: vignettes/articles/concordance-csv.Rmd
concordance-csv.Rmd

The full Master Concordance, one row per xpath, for all forms and schedules (990, 990-EZ, 990-PF and Schedules A to R), in the v1 column layout. This page is built from the package with concordance("v1"), the same call that writes concordance.csv at the root of the repository, so the table and the download always match the package. The 990-PF database on its own is concordance-990pf.csv.

The columns are described in The component tables and each variable in the data dictionaries. R users can skip the file: concordance990::concordance() returns the same table.

Using the table. Search matches any of the 24 columns, and the chips filter by form. Click a label to see the other columns of that xpath. Click a variable name to open its validation page. Download matching rows saves only the rows that match the search and filter.
